subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should resetSession be an after_compaction-only capability, or a general API available to every embedded agent hook phase?
rationale: The documented use case is post-compaction recovery, but the implementation exposes the capability through the shared run-hook context; either scope could be intentional, and that permanent plugin contract requires maintainer direction.

options.title: After-compaction only
options.body: Keep the lifecycle-owned queue but inject resetSession only into after_compaction contexts, preventing pre-run and ordinary run hooks from rotating newly written session state.

options.title: General embedded-hook API
options.body: Approve the broader contract explicitly and add phase-specific semantics and tests covering reset requests from before and after run hooks.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Do not add a public hook reset capability until a narrower owner-plugin or generic lifecycle seam is agreed.

recommendation.title: After-compaction only
recommendation.body: Keep the lifecycle-owned queue but inject resetSession only into after_compaction contexts, preventing pre-run and ordinary run hooks from rotating newly written session state.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level plugin API and session-lifecycle product contract rather than a routine implementation detail.
